'''Frontier Strongholds''' describes the 14 unaligned castles situated across Calradia in ''Realms of Dust''.  == The 14 Unaligned Holds == Because Calradia contains 67 Castles and 53 Capitals, pairing one castle per capital leaves '''14 surplus strongholds'''. Rather than granting asymmetric power to select kingdoms, these 14 locations are designated as '''Frontier Strongholds''': * '''Political Status:''' Neutral, independent territories unaligned with any of the 53 sovereign realms. * '''Strategic Purpose:''' Unclaimed fortresses open to conquest by any realm or warlord capable of taking them.  == Bound Village Allocation == The ~48 villages remaining after the 53 sovereign realms receive their 4-village domains are bound directly to these 14 Frontier Strongholds: * Each Frontier Stronghold controls approximately '''3 to 4 bound villages'''. * These villages provide an independent agrarian and recruitment base to whichever faction conquers the stronghold.  == Defense & Garrison Composition == Frontier Strongholds are fortified but lightly defended on Day 1: * '''Garrison Watch:''' 15 Tier-1 neutral/outlaw defenders. * '''Local Hearth Militia:''' 20?30 local peasant defenders on the ramparts. * '''Siege Viability:''' Capable of resisting small bandit parties, but vulnerable to any organized warband of 30?40 soldiers equipped with siege ladders.
